name: Firebase Hosting
line: Host static web apps on a global CDN with optional backend rewrites.

free.text: Spark: 10GB storage; transfer limit listed as 10GB/mo or 360MB/day

work.math: 100 GB requires the Blaze plan. The delivery estimate is $13.50 a month with 10 GB a month free, or $13.38 at 360 MB a day for 30 days. Storage is assumed to be up to 10 GB.
Cloud Run example: $2.88 for CPU + $13.38 or $13.50 for delivery, for isolated requests of 300 ms each. Startup, images, logs and network add costs that are unknown.
The small app API's partial total, plus $27.25 for Cloud SQL compute and a 10 GiB disk. Backup storage used and connection and network costs are unknown.
